Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"...Ah..."
Chachamaru"Lovely night for a moon-viewing party, haan. But why come all the way to Fudaraku? Same moon is available here."
Chachamaru"Chalo, we'll do it here only."
Kuronose"Lord of Horigoe!"
Chachamaru"His Highness, where is he? Inside?"
Chief"...Lieutenant General, what is the meaning of this! You know Kenchouji is His Highness Prince Maidono's residence, and still you surround it with soldiers? This outrage will not be tolerated!"
Chief"Withdraw your troops. At once!"
Chachamaru"Wah, Kamakura Chief giving lectures. First tell apun what YOU are doing here."
Chief"..."
Chachamaru"Don't strain yourself, yaar. Already exposed. Raichou spat it all out—joining Prince Maidono to take over the shogunate."
Raichou"Wha—"
Chachamaru"Arre? Was that not it?"
Kageaki"Our public explanation, I believe, was that Prince Maidono is threatened by anti-shogunate forces. We have sent troops for his protection."
Chachamaru"Haan, haan, that one. Sorry, Raichou. Apun mixed up the stories."
Raichou"Grr..."
Chachamaru"So there you have it, Chief. No worrying about His Highness."
Chachamaru"Apun has come to protect him. From you anti-shogunate bastards!"
Chief"...Ghh..."

ja.html:
景明「…………」
村正「……あ……」
茶々丸「月見の宴を張るにはいい夜だけど。 　わざわざ普陀楽まで来なくてもいいだろ」
茶々丸「ここでやろうぜ」
黒瀬「堀越公方！」
茶々丸「宮様はどこだい。 　中か？」
署長「……中将、如何なる存念か！ 　この建朝寺を舞殿宮殿下の御座所と知って 軍兵で囲むなど、許されぬ狼藉！」
署長「即刻、撤収して頂きたい！」
茶々丸「言えた義理かよ、鎌倉署長。 　おめーこそなんでここにいるんだって話だ」
署長「…………」
茶々丸「もうバレてんだから無理すんな。 　雷蝶が吐いたんだよ、舞殿宮と組んで幕府 を乗っ取るつもりだったって」
雷蝶「な――」
茶々丸「あれ？　違ったっけ？」
景明「ここに兵を出した理由は表向き、舞殿宮が 倒幕派に狙われているから警護する……と、 いうことであったかと」
茶々丸「あー、そうそう。 　ごめんな雷蝶、うっかり間違えちったー」
雷蝶「うぐぐ……」
茶々丸「つーわけだから署長。 　宮様のことはなんも心配しなくていいぞぅ」
茶々丸「あては宮様を守りに来たんだ。 　おめーら、倒幕派の手からなァ！」
署長「……ッッ……」

en.html:
Kageaki's adoptive father clenched his teeth so hard we could hear it. Defeat was showing plainly; against the despair coming over him, he was still struggling with all he had.

Kuronose Douji, same condition.
Ichijou Ayane was taking each breath and turning it into more hatred, more readiness to fight.

en.html:
Chachamaru spread the soldiers around us and came forward. The man of that monstrous size came with her... and Kageaki also.

A fight was coming.
The disadvantage was on our side——

No.
For me... it was the other way around.

The plan had gone completely elsewhere. But Kageaki was here. I had met him. Then an opportunity was also here.

If I used my power to bring Kageaki back to himself, I could turn this situation around!

A fight was coming.
The disadvantage was on our side——

No.

The plan had gone completely elsewhere. But Kageaki was here. I had met him. Then an opportunity was also here.

If I used my power to bring Kageaki back to himself, I could turn this situation around!

ja.html:
兵を周囲に散らして、茶々丸が前へ出てくる。
　隣の異様な巨躯の男も……そして、景明も。

　戦いになる。
　状況はこちらが不利――――

　いや。
　私にとっては……むしろ逆。

　予定とは全く違うけれど、ともかくも景明に会えた
のだ。
　なら、今は好機。

　私の力で景明を元に戻せば、この状況も変えられる！

Kuronose"Ichijou, take care! That is the Lord of Oyumi, Raichou Imagawa—"
Ichijou"The enormous overdressed peacock, haan. Heh... that saves us some trouble."
Ichijou"One of the Four Great Kubo goes down, they can't exactly continue with their party, can they?"
Raichou"...Are you suggesting that YOU will defeat ME?"
Ichijou"Your interpretation, bhosdike, is your headache. You hear a challenge, fine. You hear me reciting my multiplication tables, also fine."
Ichijou"What I'm going to do doesn't change. Chalo, Masamune!"
Masamune《HAAN!》
